checks.criterion: Selected candidate fingerprint matches the signed shortlist recommendation.
Repository remains public and fixed commit remains reachable.
Contact account is verified as an official project or maintainer-controlled account.
Chosen route permits a private, low-pressure project inquiry.
Public GitHub issue and pull-request contact remain prohibited.
Personalized message is unchanged from the signed reviewed body.
Recipient field is populated only after explicit human send authorization.
No attachment, tracking link, credential request, or private-data request is included.
Exactly one outbound message is authorized and no follow-up is authorized.
Negative, ambiguous, or no response cannot create consent.
Separate scope and written consent are ready but not sent automatically.
Customer intake and pilot execution remain unauthorized.
No pricing, contract, delivery, publication, or repository-write authority is present.
Operator has a stop path for unsolicited secrets or private data.
A no-response closure date will be recorded fourteen days after sending.
Human approver records channel, recipient, timestamp, and exact message fingerprint.
A send action is blocked unless all prior checks pass.
Current product-readiness score remains ninety-three before external evidence exists.
